verses.1: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men.
verses.2: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’
verses.7: [Not in 1 Enoch. This verse number was removed when the text was corrected to the R.H. Charles 1917 edition; see the chapter above.]

verses.1: And thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants.
verses.2: And water gushed forth from above.
verses.3: Rushing like a copious watercourse [which flowed] towards the north- west it caused clouds and dew to ascend on every side.

verses.1: And after that my grandfather Enoch gave me the teaching of all the secrets in the book in the Parables which had been given to him, and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.
verses.2: And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and makes me to tremble because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’
verses.3: And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: ‘Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of judgement (that) has gone forth upon them because of those who have thus led them out?’
verses.4: And it came to pass when he stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of Yahuah (Lord); for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).
verses.5: Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’

verses.1: And again I saw with mine eyes as I slept, and I saw the heaven above, and behold a star fell from heaven, and it arose and eat and pastured amongst those oxen.
verses.2: And after that I saw the large and the black oxen, and behold they all changed their stalls and pastures and their cattle, and began to live with each other.
verses.3: And again I saw in the vision, and looked towards the heaven, and behold I saw many stars descend and cast themselves down from heaven to that first star, and they became bulls amongst those cattle and pastured with them [amongst them].
verses.4: And I looked at them and saw, and behold they all let out their privy members, like horses, and began to cover the cows of the oxen, and they all became pregnant and bare elephants, camels, and asses.
verses.5: And all the oxen feared them and were affrighted at them, and began to bite with their teeth and to devour, and to gore with their horns.
verses.6: And they began, moreover, to devour those oxen; and behold all the children of the earth began to tremble and quake before them and to flee from them.

verses.1: ‘And now, my son Methuselah, call to me all thy brothers And gather together to me all the sons of thy mother; For the word calls me, And the spirit is poured out upon me, That I may show you everything That shall befall you for ever.’
verses.2: And thereupon Methuselah went and summoned to him all his brothers and assembled his relatives.
verses.3: And he spake unto all the children of righteousness and said: ‘Hear, ye sons of Enoch, all the words of your father, And hearken aright to the voice of my mouth; For I exhort you and say unto you, beloved:
verses.4: Love uprightness and walk therein. And draw not nigh to uprightness with a double heart, And associate not with those of a double heart, But walk in righteousness, my sons. And it shall guide you on good paths, And righteousness shall be your companion.
verses.5: For I know that violence must increase on the earth, And a great chastisement be executed on the earth, And all unrighteousness come to an end: Yea, it shall be cut off from its roots, And its whole structure be destroyed.
verses.6: And unrighteousness shall again be consummated on the earth, And all the deeds of unrighteousness and of violence And transgression shall prevail in a twofold degree.
verses.7: And when sin and unrighteousness and blasphemy And violence in all kinds of deeds increase, And apostasy and transgression and uncleanness increase, A great chastisement shall come from heaven upon all these, And the holy Yahuah (Lord) will come forth with wrath and chastisement To execute judgement on earth.
verses.8: In those days violence shall be cut off from its roots, And the roots of unrighteousness together with deceit, And they shall be destroyed from under heaven.
verses.9: And all the idols of the heathen shall be abandoned, And the temples burned with fire, And they shall remove them from the whole earth, And they (i.e. the heathen) shall be cast into the judgement of fire, And shall perish in wrath and in grievous judgement for ever.
verses.10: And the righteous shall arise from their sleep, And wisdom shall arise and be given unto them.
verses.11: [And after that the roots of unrighteousness shall be cut off, and the sinners shall be destroyed by the sword... shall be cut off from the blasphemers in every place, and those who plan violence and those who commit blasphemy shall perish by the sword.]
verses.12: And after that there shall be another, the eighth week, that of righteousness, And a sword shall be given to it that a righteous judgement may be executed on the oppressors, And sinners shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous.
verses.13: And at its close they shall acquire houses through their righteousness, And a house shall be built for the Great King in glory for evermore,
verses.14: And all mankind shall look to the path of uprightness. And after that, in the ninth week, the righteous judgement shall be revealed to the whole world, And all the works of the godless shall vanish from all the earth, And the world shall be written down for destruction.
verses.15: And after this, in the tenth week in the seventh part, There shall be the great eternal judgement, In which He will execute vengeance amongst the angels.
verses.16: And the first heaven shall depart and pass away, And a new heaven shall appear, And all the powers of the heavens shall give sevenfold light.
verses.17: And after that there will be many weeks without number for ever, And all shall be in goodness and righteousness, And sin shall no more be mentioned for ever.
verses.18: And now I tell you, my sons, and show you The paths of righteousness and the paths of violence. Yea, I will show them to you again That ye may know what will come to pass.
verses.19: And now, hearken unto me, my sons, And walk in the paths of righteousness, And walk not in the paths of violence; For all who walk in the paths of unrighteousness shall perish for ever.’

verses.1: Observe the heaven, ye children of heaven, and every work of the El Elyon (Most High), and fear ye Him and work no evil in His presence.
verses.2: If He closes the windows of heaven, and withholds the rain and the dew from descending on the earth on your account, what will ye do then?
verses.3: And if He sends His anger upon you because of your deeds, ye cannot petition Him; for ye spake proud and insolent words against His righteousness: therefore ye shall have no peace.
verses.4: And see ye not the sailors of the ships, how their ships are tossed to and fro by the waves, and are shaken by the winds, and are in sore trouble?
verses.5: And therefore do they fear because all their goodly possessions go upon the sea with them, and they have evil forebodings of heart that the sea will swallow them and they will perish therein.
verses.6: Are not the entire sea and all its waters, and all its movements, the work of the El Elyon (Most High), and has He not set limits to its doings, and confined it throughout by the sand?
verses.7: And at His reproof it is afraid and dries up, and all its fish die and all that is in it; but ye sinners that are on the earth fear Him not.
verses.8: Has He not made the heaven and the earth, and all that is therein? Who has given understanding and wisdom to everything that moves on the earth and in the sea?
verses.9: Do not the sailors of the ships fear the sea? Yet sinners fear not the El Elyon (Most High).

verses.1: In those days Yahuah (Lord) bade (them) to summon and testify to the children of earth concerning their wisdom: Show (it) unto them; for ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth.
verses.2: For I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness in their lives; and ye shall have peace: rejoice, ye children of uprightness. Amen.

verses.1: And after some days my son Methuselah took a wife for his son Lamech, and she became pregnant by him and bore a son.
verses.2: And his body was white as snow and red as the blooming of a rose, and the hair of his head and his long locks were white as wool, and his eyes beautiful. And when he opened his eyes, he lighted up the whole house like the sun, and the whole house was very bright.
verses.3: And thereupon he arose in the hands of the midwife, opened his mouth, and conversed with Yahuah (Lord) of righteousness.
verses.4: And his father Lamech was afraid of him and fled, and came to his father Methuselah.
verses.5: And he said unto him: ‘I have begotten a strange son, diverse from and unlike man, and resembling the sons of the Elohim (God) of heaven; and his nature is different and he is not like us, and his eyes are as the rays of the sun, and his countenance is glorious.
verses.6: And it seems to me that he is not sprung from me but from the angels, and I fear that in his days a wonder may be wrought on the earth.
verses.7: And now, my father, I am here to petition thee and implore thee that thou mayst go to Enoch, our father, and learn from him the truth, for his dwelling-place is amongst the angels.’
verses.8: And when Methuselah heard the words of his son, he came to me to the ends of the earth; for he had heard that I was there, and he cried aloud, and I heard his voice and I came to him. And I said unto him: ‘Behold, here am I, my son, wherefore hast thou come to me?’
verses.9: And he answered and said: ‘Because of a great cause of anxiety have I come to thee, and because of a disturbing vision have I approached.
verses.10: And now, my father, hear me: unto Lamech my son there hath been born a son, the like of whom there is none, and his nature is not like man’s nature, and the colour of his body is whiter than snow and redder than the bloom of a rose, and the hair of his head is whiter than white wool, and his eyes are like the rays of the sun, and he opened his eyes and thereupon lighted up the whole house.
verses.11: And he arose in the hands of the midwife, and opened his mouth and blessed Yahuah (Lord) of heaven.
verses.12: And his father Lamech became afraid and fled to me, and did not believe that he was sprung from him, but that he was in the likeness of the angels of heaven; and behold I have come to thee that thou mayst make known to me the truth.’
verses.13: And I, Enoch, answered and said unto him: ‘Yahuah (Lord) will do a new thing on the earth, and this I have already seen in a vision, and make known to thee that in the generation of my father Jared some of the angels of heaven transgressed the word of Yahuah (Lord).
verses.14: And behold they commit sin and transgress the law, and have united themselves with women and commit sin with them, and have married some of them, and have begot children by them.
verses.15: Yea, there shall come a great destruction over the whole earth, and there shall be a deluge and a great destruction for one year.
verses.16: And this son who has been born unto you shall be left on the earth, and his three children shall be saved with him: when all mankind that are on the earth shall die [he and his sons shall be saved].
verses.17: And they shall produce on the earth giants not according to the spirit, but according to the flesh, and there shall be a great punishment on the earth, and the earth shall be cleansed from all impurity.
verses.18: And now make known to thy son Lamech that he who has been born is in truth his son, and call his name Noah; for he shall be left to you, and he and his sons shall be saved from the destruction, which shall come upon the earth on account of all the sin and all the unrighteousness, which shall be consummated on the earth in his days.
verses.19: And after that there shall be still more unrighteousness than that which was first consummated on the earth; for I know the mysteries of the holy ones; for He, Yahuah (Lord), has showed me and informed me, and I have read (them) in the heavenly tablets.

verses.1: And I saw written on them that generation upon generation shall transgress, till a generation of righteousness arises, and transgression is destroyed and sin passes away from the earth, and all manner of good comes upon it.
verses.2: And now, my son, go and make known to thy son Lamech that this son, which has been born, is in truth his son, and that (this) is no lie.’
verses.3: And when Methuselah had heard the words of his father Enoch—for he had shown to him everything in secret—he returned and showed (them) to him and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.

The reckoning recorded for ever — the luminaries, months and festivals shown by Uriel
The leaders who watch the seasons and festivals — the four who divide the year
The heaven cast down, the earth swallowed — the deluge foreseen
The heaven collapsed and fell to the earth — the heavens undone
Enoch the intercessor — that a remnant may remain on the earth
The days of Noah — the Flood as the pattern of the coming judgment
Thy dominion throughout all generations — the everlasting throne
Nothing hidden from Thee — the eyes on the throne
Thou seest what Azazel has done — the Watchers, the women, and the giants
Leave me a posterity on earth — the plea for a seed and the remnant left
The white bull come forth from the earth — Adam, the formed seed-line
The black bull gores the red — Cain and Abel, and the seed-war begins
The cow seeks the red bull and laments — Abel's blood that yet speaketh
The second white bull — Seth, the seed appointed, the white line toward Messiah
The white ones come down to bind the fallen stars
The host of the high ones reserved in chains for judgement
Enoch taken up to the tower to behold the end
The fallen star bound hand and foot, cast into the deep abyss
The sword given the giants — they smite each other and the earth quakes
The white bull instructed in a secret — born a bull, became a man, built the vessel
The torrents and fountains — the cattle perish, the vessel floats, the earth dries
The white bull becomes a man, the vessel, and the flood
The sheep born of Jacob and the wolves of Egypt
The sheep saved from the wolves, the Lord who comes down, and the sea
Sinai, the covenant, and the house built for the Lord of the sheep
The sheep go astray, are forsaken, and given to the wild beasts
The seventy shepherds who destroy more than they were commanded
The ram raised from the flock, and the house with the lofty tower
The great horn raised — the eyes opened and the rams run to it
The horn they could not break — the Lord of the sheep comes to its help
The throne in the pleasant land and the sealed books opened
The fallen stars and the seventy shepherds judged — the false shepherds reckoned
The new house, greater and loftier — the New Jerusalem, the mountain of the house
The eyes opened, the sheep gathered — the awakening of the scattered houses
The great white bull born — the Messiah and all transformed into white bulls
The book written for the generations — preserve it, hand it on, add nothing
Days appointed for all things — and the sinners who alter the order
The righteous one arises and walks in the paths of righteousness — eternal light, and sin seen no more
A complete doctrine of wisdom — the law of the luminaries, exact and recorded
The leaders of the stars keep their stations — and men who err by them take them for gods
The plant of uprightness and the elect of the world — what Enoch learned from the tablets
The paths of righteousness and the paths of violence — all who walk in unrighteousness shall perish
The apostate generation, and the elect righteous chosen for sevenfold instruction
The plant of righteousness, the law, and the enclosure — judgment and righteousness as the way
The two ways — choose the paths of righteousness, that ye may live
Woe to you who trust in your riches — they will not deliver in the day of affliction
Your riches shall not endure — the sinner's glory withers and goes into the furnace
Woe to you who feast in luxury and tread upon the poor
Woe to those who pervert the words of uprightness and transgress the eternal law
Woe to the lying witnesses, the false weights, and those who persecute the righteous
Where are your riches now? — the rich man's wealth perishes
Fear not the sinners, ye righteous — the two paths and the way that lives
Woe to those who tread on the lowly with their might
Woe to the mighty who oppress the righteous — the day of your destruction is coming
Gold gotten in unrighteousness — the boast of full granaries
The mighty who oppress the righteous, and the furnace at the end of their splendour
Be hopeful, ye righteous — the two paths and the fountain of life
We have become rich — the riches that testify against the rich
The prayer of the righteous reaches the Lord — and the days of your judgement come
The sinners will become a shame and perish — the end of the splendour
The prayer of the righteous reaches him, and the riches of the unrighteous flow away like water
The luxury that perishes — woe to the adorned and the rich
Sin was not sent — man made it himself
All your deeds are written down in heaven
Woe to the obstinate who eat blood
Woe to those who write down lying and godless words
Woe to those who transgress the eternal law
They worship a stone, and in an instant shall perish
Blessed are they who walk in the path of His righteousness
Woe to the false measure and the house built on others' toil
The prayers of the righteous as a memorial before the Most High
The blood to the horse's breast — the day of slaughter
The Most High arises — the supper of the great Elohim
Guardians for the righteous — kept as the apple of an eye
Woe to the rich oppressor — riches shall not save
Heaven testifies — the rain and dew withheld
Fear not, ye souls of the righteous — wait for the day of judgement
As we die, so die the righteous — the sinners' taunt over the dead, and its answer
Woe to the strong in unrighteousness who tread the poor — the eternal law unbroken
Content to eat and drink and acquire wealth — whither will ye flee from the fire?
The oath: the spirits of the righteous dead shall live and rejoice
Written in the holy books — the lot of the righteous dead, and the names that are blotted out
Blessed are the sinners, they have seen all their days — and then Sheol
They helped those who robbed us — the rulers who sided with the oppressor
Two lots in one chapter: the righteous dead rejoice, the prosperous sinner goes down to Sheol
Ye shall shine as the lights of heaven — companions of the hosts of heaven
Your names are written before the glory of the Great One — blotted out, never added
Every sin written down — and the sinners who alter the words and write their own books
The sinners growing strong and prospering — keep afar from their violence
The books given to the righteous teach the paths of uprightness
I and My Son will be united with them for ever in the paths of uprightness
Ye are their guides, and a recompense over the whole earth
Show it unto them — the wisdom of the righteous as a light to the children of earth
Ye shall have peace — the end of the refrain that gave the sinners none
He will comfort the earth after all the destruction — Noah, the sign of what is coming
A generation of righteousness arises — the plant of righteousness after the destruction
Generation upon generation shall transgress — the violence that brings the judgement
He called the name of that son Noah — comfort after the destruction, comfort for the cursed ground
The names blotted from the book of life
The righteous sleep, awake, and shine in light
Those born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous are resplendent
The two ways — the good keep the law to the end

sample_cards.note: Isaiah 26:20 — *Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.* Isaiah hides the chosen people through the wrath, the same sparing of the elect in the day of tribulation that Enoch's blessing secures.

Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* Yahusha names Himself the Son of Adam, the very title 1 Enoch gives the Elect One who proceeds from the Head of Days. The holy angels come with him; Enoch's *ten thousands of His set-apart ones* are the seed of promise, gathered and coming with him — and on the throne of his glory he sifts the gathered, the sheep from the goats.

Deuteronomy 33:2 — *And he said, Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.* Moses' blessing fixes Enoch's Sinai-coming to the giving of the fiery law, so the One who treads upon Sinai comes to uphold His covenant, not to cancel it.

sample_thread.title: The Sun in His Ordained Course — Observe and Know His Works
sample_thread.summary_md: *And again, observe ye the days of summer how the sun is above the earth over against it. And you seek shade and shelter by reason of the heat of the sun, and the earth also burns with growing heat, and so you cannot tread on the earth, or on a rock by reason of its heat.* (1 Enoch 4:1) The same heat Enoch tells you to feel on your own skin is the witness the Tanakh sings: *In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race. His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.* (Psalm 19:6) The sun does not wander — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalm 104:19) — because Yahuah (God) set it on the fourth day for exactly this: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years* (Genesis 1:14). 1 Enoch's own kinsman-book says the same of that fourth-day light: *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years* (Jubilees 2:9). Enoch's burning summer is not idle weather-watching: it is the appointed luminary keeping the moedim by the Creator's order, the same Torah-ordered calendar — it ain't new. The lights were never given to be worshipped, but to keep the times He set; the wise heed them, and through them recognize Him.
